# Starting a vegetable garden

A few square meters of sun are enough to grow salad for a family through the summer.

## Sun and soil

Vegetables want six hours of direct sun. Loosen the soil and mix in compost before planting.

## What to plant first

Lettuce, radishes and herbs grow fast and forgive mistakes. Tomatoes need stakes and steady water.
